loadServerDom.summary: Installs the server DOM: the globals HTMLElement and customElements the modules of the components need on the server, and the classes of the native elements.
loadServerDom.description:
A component extends HTMLElement, and @WebComponent defines it in customElements, as soon as their modules are evaluated: Node has neither. loadServerDom() installs the ones of the server DOM, which hold the attributes, the classes and the shadow root of an element without rendering anything. It also installs the classes of the native HTML elements, such as HTMLButtonElement or HTMLInputElement, which a customized built-in element extends through customElementOf() when its module is evaluated: on the server they are all its HTMLElement, so customElementOf() gives CustomElement there. A global already there, such as the one of a browser or of a DOM emulated by the tests, is kept.

It must run before the modules of @xaendar/core and of the components are evaluated: the entry of the server calls it right after loadSignals(), and imports them afterwards, with import(). A static import is evaluated before the code of the module, wherever it is written.

The server DOM has no document and no window: the code of a component reading them in its constructor, in a field initializer or in onInit throws on the server, unless it checks typeof first. A class defined again with the tag and the name of the one defined before replaces it, as the dev server does when a module changes. See renderToString().

order.title: Before anything else
order.body: In the entry of the server, the polyfill and the server DOM come first, the modules of Xaendar afterwards.
